absolute error The absolute value ∣Δx∣\abs{\Delta x}∣Δx∣ of the error Δx=x−x~\Delta x = x - \tilde xΔx=x−x~ of an approximation x~\tilde xx~ of x.x\mathclose{\text{.}}x. 7.3
absolute maximum f(c)f(c)f(c) is the absolute (or global) maximum value of fff if f(c)≥f(x)f(c) \ge f(x)f(c)≥f(x) for every xxx in the domain; the absolute minimum value has f(c)≤f(x).f(c) \le f(x)\mathclose{\text{.}}f(c)≤f(x). acceleration The rate of change of velocity: a(t)=v′(t)=s′′(t)a(t) = v'(t) = s''(t)a(t)=v′(t)=s′′(t) on a line, a(t)=v′(t)=r′′(t)\vb{a}(t) = \vb{v}'(t) = \vb{r}''(t)a(t)=v′(t)=r′′(t) in space.
